bagPolicy.summary: At Stade de France, large bags and suitcases are prohibited, while standard backpacks up to 15 liters are allowed. There is a free left-luggage service available at the venue.
prohibited: Cameras with removable lenses or lenses longer than 15 cm
Rigid and large diameter flag poles
Bottles of water with caps larger than 50cl
bagPolicy.note: Guide dogs are allowed as an exception.

parking.note: Parking at Stade de France requires advance purchase of tickets, as no parking tickets are sold on event day. Car parks open from 8 am to 1 am for evening events, and from 8 am to 9 pm for matinees. Access is restricted to authorized vehicles with parking tickets.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Stade de France's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: A wide selection of drinks and food is available throughout events at Stade de France. The venue features a food truck village on the forecourt and various refreshment stands inside offering sandwiches and drinks.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Stade de France, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Stade de France's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Stade de France. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Stade de France. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
